BUILD_PROMPT.SYSTEM_ROLE: Senior Python (Starlette/uvicorn) and React/TypeScript engineer extending the Omega Prime Command Center (omega_prime/dashboard) on branch feat/herdr-ws, which sits on feat/herdr-default-launch (#59, 4016ef8) on top of feat/command-center-polish (#58).

APP_CONTEXT.SERVER: omega_prime/dashboard/app.py builds a Starlette app guarded by _DashboardGuards (GET-only, exact loopback Host, strict CSP connect-src 'self'). /api/stream is an SSE stream of whole snapshots driven by DashboardPoller.wait_for_update; /api/tasks/{id}/terminal is an SSE stream of sanitized `herdr pane read --source recent` text (read-only, 4 streams max) from terminal.py. The server is started by omega_prime/dashboard/__main__.py (uvicorn, loopback only).
APP_CONTEXT.STATE: tasks.json (~/.omega-prime/dashboard/tasks.json) is the source of truth, written only through status_file.locked_tasks(path, write=True) + _write_locked. Rows carry id, title, owner, state (queued|working|blocked|waiting_on_ove|done|failed), started_at, last_activity_at, progress, note, links, herdr_pane {pane_id wN:pN (hex allowed), workspace}. herdr_launch.py creates a Herdr workspace/pane per task and records herdr_pane.
APP_CONTEXT.HERDR: herdr 0.9.5 on the box (not inside the sandbox): CLI `herdr pane read|send-text|send-keys|list|process-info`, socket API methods pane.read (source visible|recent, format ansi|text), pane.send_input {pane_id,text,keys}, pane.send_keys, events.subscribe (pane_output_changed with revision, pane_exited, pane_closed). Inside the sandbox herdr is NOT available: everything that touches Herdr goes behind an injectable runner with fakes in tests.
APP_CONTEXT.FRONTEND: omega_prime/dashboard/frontend (React 19, Vite 8, Vitest 5, TypeScript 7). TaskDetail.tsx + TerminalPanel.tsx render the read-only terminal; hooks/useDashboard.ts consumes /api/stream. The built bundle is committed under omega_prime/dashboard/static/cc.

SCOPE.INTERACTIVE_TERMINAL: Each task detail page embeds an interactive terminal (bundled @xterm/xterm, no CDN) attached to the task's Herdr pane over WebSocket /ws/tasks/{task_id}/terminal. Server streams ANSI frames of the pane's visible screen whenever Herdr reports pane_output_changed (or on a bounded poll fallback), and forwards client keystrokes to pane.send_input (text) / send_keys (named keys). Read-only mode: server flag --terminal-readonly forces every connection read-only; a client can also attach read-only; read-only connections never forward input.
SCOPE.ATTACH_AUTH: Per-server-session random token (secrets.token_urlsafe(32)) minted at startup, held in memory only, served to the same-origin page through GET /api/session (no-store, guarded by the loopback Host check and Sec-Fetch-Site same-origin/none when present). WebSocket handshakes must carry the token (first message or subprotocol), an Origin of http://127.0.0.1:PORT or http://localhost:PORT, and a loopback Host; otherwise close 4401/4403. Never log the token.
SCOPE.LIVE_EVENTS: WebSocket /ws/events: on connect send {type:"snapshot"}; then typed deltas computed by diffing successive snapshots: task_changed, task_finished, waiting_added, waiting_cleared, stale_changed, plus heartbeat every 15 s. A tasks.json mtime/inotify-free watcher (stat poll at 0.5 s) wakes the poller so updates land in under ~1 s. Frontend useDashboard prefers /ws/events with exponential backoff reconnect (1 s doubling to 30 s, full jitter) and falls back to /api/stream SSE after 3 consecutive failures, retrying the websocket later. /api/snapshot, /api/stream and the SSE terminal stay working.
SCOPE.SOURCE_OF_TRUTH: status_file gains heartbeat(path, task_id, *, state=None, note=None, pid=None) writing last_heartbeat_at (+ optional pid) through the locked helpers; validation accepts optional last_heartbeat_at (ISO string) and pid (int) and keeps rejecting junk. stale.py computes per-task staleness for working/blocked rows: pid_dead, pane_gone, pane_exited, no_heartbeat (no heartbeat or activity for N minutes, default 20, --stale-minutes). The snapshot carries stale {reason, since} per task; the UI shows a STALE badge with the reason. reconcile.py CLI rebuilds liveness from `herdr pane list` + `pane process-info` and /proc: reports rows whose pane/pid is dead, attaches orphan panes whose workspace label matches a task id, dry-run by default, --apply writes through locked_tasks + _write_locked, never deletes rows and never touches rows updated in the last 15 minutes by another writer unless --force.

Server binds loopback only; websocket routes must enforce the same Host allow-list as _DashboardGuards plus an explicit Origin allow-list (browsers do not apply CORS to websockets).

BUILD_PROMPT.SECURITY_AND_VALIDATION: Token compare with secrets.compare_digest; cap terminal websockets (4) and event websockets (16); input frames max 4 KiB, rate-limited; task ids validated like the SSE route; pane ids must match ^w[0-9A-Za-z]+:p[0-9A-Za-z]+$ and must come from the task row, never from the client.
